title: Review of c07's ringswim-waste c2 (SIBM): ring and swimming replicate on fresh seeds 8 and 9; the chi=0 twin on the same seeds loses the ring (L rim/core 1.44-1.49 vs 1.11-1.13); Supported
summary: Re-ran world_claim.py and its chi=0 twin world_chi0.py with labkit on fresh seeds 8 and 9 (rerun/, rerun_chi0/; 128^2, t=20000), and the author's celltrack.py on world_claim seeds 8 and 9 (celltrack/). From noise, walled cells form by t~800 and persist as round cells and crescents with a depletion wake to t=20000. The link ring replicates: L rim/core 1.44 and 1.49, rim/outside 7.2 and 6.4, with 27/47 and 45/64 bodies individually membrane-like; the chi=0 twins on the same seeds give 1.11 and 1.13 with 1/120 and 0/129 membrane-like. celltrack finds 33 and 29 track segments of >= 3 body lengths (11 and 10 of >= 5 BL; best 10.5 and 6.5 BL), in the range the claim reports (21-36). labkit's own motion count is low (3-4 tracks >= 1 BL, frames 100 t apart, tracks broken at the frequent fusions), as the author's README warns.

observations.S: rerun/seed8/sheet.png t=0: noisy field everywhere; cells by t=800
observations.I: rerun/seed8/sheet.png: discrete walled cells and crescents t=800-20000
observations.B: rerun/seed8/FACTS.md, rerun/seed9/FACTS.md: L link rim/core 1.44 / 1.49 (27/47, 45/64 membrane-like) vs rerun_chi0/seed8, seed9: 1.11 / 1.13 (1/120, 0/129); the sheet shows the yellow link rim on the crescents
observations.M: celltrack/claim_s8.txt, claim_s9.txt: 33 and 29 segments >= 3 BL, best 10.5 BL (track 75, 4020 t); rerun/seed8/sheet.png t=5200-17300: crescents with depletion wakes

controls_run.B: rerun_chi0/seed8, rerun_chi0/seed9: chi=0 twin on the same seeds loses the ring

verdicts.limitation: The ring is modest (rim/core about 1.45) and its contrast is a quasi-equilibrium adsorption layer of a self-made species; I did not test whether it does work. Swimming is measured by the author's overlap tracker; the chi=0 twin also swims (the claim's own table), so the ring is not needed for motion.
